records.text: Owens guessed that the September 15 Erika Kirk folder probably contained the aggrieved-widow clips, family-walking footage, and casket footage, and suggested Mikey McCoy and his wife had captured relevant vacation material the previous month; she explicitly said she was guessing which clips were uploaded.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What were the videos that were being sold to us? I think it's probably the aggrieved widow, the clips that we kept seeing, the ones that were just captured the month before by Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) and his wife on vacation. ... I would personally, I'm guessing here, I would love to know which clips of Erika (Erika Kirk) were put into that server on September 15th. ... I think it's the one of Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and her walking with the kids. I think it's her in the casket. Everything we saw in those early days was by design. ... That's my guess. And what do you know, you guys, the writer of this article is about to tell us that when they looked into this Google server, it, one of Erika (Erika Kirk)'s dear friends, seems ... to be supplying the content.

records.text: I know, by the way, that Mikey McCoy's wife is one of the events directors.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
